examined_formations.title: AI_USAGE_BASED_SOFTWARE_SPEND_CONTROL
examined_formations.chinese_title: 企业AI用量型软件支出与Credits控制
examined_formations.evidence_summary: 2026 vendors are moving AI features to credit/usage billing, but native vendor budget controls plus procurement/spend products already track committed-versus-consumed AI spend, overages, renewals, utilization and negotiation.

examined_formations.title: EU_AI_ACT_CONTINUOUS_EVIDENCE_AUTOMATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 欧盟AI法案持续证据与审计自动化
examined_formations.evidence_summary: The current market already sells self-serve and enterprise AI Act classification, Annex IV documentation, evidence collection, monitoring, audit trails and CI-linked compliance at transparent recurring prices.

examined_formations.title: DIGITAL_PRODUCT_PASSPORT_PPWR_AUTOMATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 数字产品护照与PPWR合规自动化
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current products already sell volume-priced digital product passports, ERP/PIM integration, PPWR documentation and EPR reporting across EU jurisdictions; this is a paid software category rather than an unowned control edge.

examined_formations.title: EV_FLEET_HOME_CHARGING_REIMBURSEMENT
examined_formations.chinese_title: 电动车队员工家充自动报销
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Fleet platforms already meter home charging, assign electricity tariffs, produce reimbursement reports and bundle settlement/billing workflows at per-vehicle recurring prices.

examined_formations.title: SUBCONTRACTOR_COI_COMPLIANCE_TRACKING
examined_formations.chinese_title: 分包商保险凭证COI持续跟踪
examined_formations.evidence_summary: The exact collection, expiry-reminder, compliance-dashboard and vendor-update workflow already exists as both free narrow software and paid SaaS, collapsing a thin independent orchestration layer.

examined_formations.title: API_DEPRECATION_SUNSET_MONITORING
examined_formations.evidence_summary: PageCrawl directly sells changelog/API documentation monitoring for breaking changes and deprecations with paid plans and MCP access; the exact alerting control loop is already productized at low cost.
